I was sure the Labyrinth was going to look
rehashed. She really did manage to avoid it.
I-is this…!?
Blehhhh! D-Darling, this song is…!

Her demonic song gouges out my entrails,
jolts my brain, and shakes my very soul.

…could anyone but her perpetrate such
a devilish act? No, I think not.

Yes! The blood idol returns from Hell!
#C236196003Elizabeth Báthory#CDEF: Encore Ver.!

#C236196003Saber#CDEF… I can hardly believe it…
Did you hear that, father? I may have
just made my first frien―――

But this time it's different! I'M the #C000246204Sentinel#CDEF,
which means I have the leading role!
I'm not some Master's pawn this round!
Who's your new Master?

I'll only take top idol appropriate questions.
"What are your plans?" "How will you do this
year?" Or maybe the truth about some scandal!
What I want to know is――

Yeah, maybe I'll start by releasing my
NEW single… It's titled
"Twintails and Jinxes."
That's way too ambitious…!
Could this idol actually be a GENIUS…!?

…so it seems.
What's it like, having anyone and everyone
make advances on you?
My left hand faintly aches.

…huh?
No way. This IS #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF,
but even she can't be THIS easy―――

But now she's asking for other questions…
All I wanted to know was who her Master is…

Huff… huff… now I get it.
This is the hate #RUBS   Sentinels#RUBElead actors#REND get.
Fine with me…

Hahahahahahaha!
Looks like it's my turn, at last!
The Great Master S has arrived! Hup!

Oh, I get it.
By "interesting," she meant
THAT kind of "interesting."
Hahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
Then #C236196003Shinji#CDEF is #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's new Master!?

Here's a complaint I want to make:
why is my attendant such a dull rat?

#C236196003Rani#CDEF…
Please don't bring that up…

…regardless,
this isn't the time to be feeling down.
Gyaahffu!?

HEY! What's the big idea, #C236196003BB#CDEF!?
This is all HER fault!

There's no way I would ever attack you, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.
The reason being―――
Wha―――WHAT…?

Look here.
It annoys me to hear the same
obvious fact over and over.

Excuse me, Seaweed? May you please
not bother my kind Darling with
your half-assery?

Well then, I'll let you handle the rest.
King, be very careful not to let #C236196003Eli#CDEF's
secrets be stolen.

These are programs I designed for this level.
You guys are gonna game over instantly.

So, show me your best struggle.
The game starts, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.

That's the spirit, Darling!
Let's put the fear of the GODS
into those insolent children!

*kgh*… Well, even I didn't think this would
be enough to stop you.
Please don't jinx me.

Damn, a trap…!?
―――Here it comes, Master!

*sigh*. Please, seriously. Enough of this.
It's a big drain on my HP and MP,
considering my class. …hm, huh?
I follow #C236196003#SVT#CDEF's gaze and look behind.

This is… #C236196003Sakura#CDEF, please check the
Labyrinth's layout code.

Okay―――Ah, so there IS a spot with
some appended instructions. I think this is
#C236196003Shinji#CDEF's gimmick.

If you try to continue on, enemies will
forcibly spawn like before and block
your path, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

Well done.
All signs of the problem enemy are
gone from the floor!

Okay. We're all set to overwrite it!
Aaand… click.

I ask,
"What happened to #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF?"

HUH? Seriously? You want to talk to THAT pest?
Talking to her is a waste of time.

To some extent, hiding a #C000246204Sentinel#CDEF
could be considered the ideal defense.
Uhhh………?

For me, I get an uneasy feeling that a very different
flag is being set…
………pfft.
Horns!?
We do NOT!

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF, you appear to have accumulated
a lot of fatigue. I recommend that

I'm concerned about #C236196003Rin#CDEF.

Searching the Labyrinth is nice and all,

What's wrong, Praetor?

#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. After you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
please have yourself a rest in your
private room.
Even in cyberspace, you need proper rest.

Once you activate the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF,
use it to get back here.
I'll bet you're exhausted, #C236196003#NICK#CDEF.

#[Mr.][Ms.]##C236196003 #NICK#CDEF, return to base for now.
Let's discuss our plan
in the #C000246204Student Council Room#CDEF.

#C236196003Sakura#CDEF's worried state gets across to
me even over the transmission.

She's right, it would be best if
we returned to the #C000246204Old School Building#CDEF.

We obtained the #C000246204SG#CDEF. Let's return to the
#C000246204Old School Building#CDEF for the time being.
We can come again after we recover.

We got the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
Mission complete.
Let's head home and get some rest.

Where are you going? We secured the #C000246204SG#CDEF.
There's nothing urgent to tend to.
Back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF, now.

Hrrrm? Where are you going, #C236196003#FAMILY
#GIVEN#CDEF? Where are you going,
leaving me behind?

For a second there, I was thinking about
leaving #C236196003Gatou#CDEF and heading back,
but it probably won't rest easy on my conscience,
so let's turn back.

Wait, Praetor. If we're going to head back,
it'll behoove us for the future to have
the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF activated.

Master, let's look for the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF.
It should be around here somewhere…

We don't need to walk all the way back.
We can use the #C000246204checkpoint#CDEF to reach the
old school in a flash. Very nifty.

M-my stomach is at its limit…
I want to hurry back to #C000246204My Room#CDEF and get some rest…

Before we go to the next floor,
let's #C000246204head back to the Student Council Room#CDEF.
We need to hand over the data we got from #C236196003Green Archer#CDEF.
He gave his life to entrust us with it.

Huh? You're still in the #C000246204Sakura Labyrinth#CDEF?
Come on, there's nothing to do there.
Get your butt back here!

We'll talk about what comes next tomorrow,
so #C000246204come back and get some rest#CDEF.
After, drop by the Student Council Room.

We're in a race against time.
We need to hurry to the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF――!

I can't let #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's hopes go to waste.
Let's press on so we can catch up to #C236196003Meltlilith#CDEF!

Praetor, I've grown tired. Let us return
to My Room and have ourselves a bath.

I know how you feel, but knowing
when to rest is also part of the battle.
Let's head back to My Room.

Darling, now is the time for rest.
Let's return to our room and
recover our strength.

What an impatient #[man][woman]#. Laboring away
is not all there is to life, you know?
When it's time to rest, rest.

Straight from János Hill, I will descend～♪
From up high, right to youuu～♪
Aaaand run you through, blood splatters too!
Ugh. This voice…

………it had completely escaped me―
what THAT characteristic of hers is.

Her unmatched singing voice is spoiled by
her unmatched tone-deafness.

Alright, are you ready?
I'm going to K I L L  I T on every chart
I'm not on鷙!

Here we meet once again. I expected no
less from my rival. Even I can't compete
with your perseverance.

However! If anyone is to be called an idol,
it's ME! MY singing surpasses all
Heroic Spirits, all artists!

That's the lesson I'm going to teach you!
And forget the annoying panel of judges format―
we'll have the fans vote!

Heh… You're quite sensible, aren't you, #C236196003Saber#CDEF?
Thinking about it, sure.
I approve of that format!

You know, I've thought that way for a long time.
They're called "judges," but they don't
understand my songs in the least.

I know. I know what you mean.
You too have been tormented by the plebeians
who care not for the arts.

Mhm. I know it's unwise,
but I'm going to say it:
―――The two of us are frenemies!

N-no! You mustn't, #C236196003Eliza#CDEF! If I want to be the
top star, she'll be my greatest obstacle―――
I can't be getting along with her…!

But as my rival,
I'll be letting you hear my special, new songs.
Be sure to look forward to it!

It's a little late for me to chime in,
but I agree with getting rid of the panel of judges format.

I mean, it's just such a shame to have judges.
True harmony is letting only trained #RUBS     fans #RUBEsupporters#REND hype things up.

But hey, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF. I know you haven't forgotten
your two losses to us. Aren't you at a
bit of a disadvantage in this battle?

What chart would YOU be on? From when?
Sorry, but I don't recall seeing your name
pop up on even a single chart.

What do you mean "Encore Ver."!? Come back after
you've at least swapped some colors. You don't
look like you're ANY tougher.

"Kill it on the charts"? You're quite resolute.
But the charts will turn from top 100 to top 0―
Are you fine with that?

Hmph. That was just the start of my
opening performance. I'd say every idol
has things they'd rather keep buried…
She's "not an ordinary Servant"…

#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF proudly states,
but a contract with a Master ought to be
essential to drawing out her power.

Besides, #C236196003BB#CDEF said she gave her an "interesting Master."
I don't think she'll give me a straight answer,
but I'll try asking.

Hmph. You're unbelievably third-rate.
I can't have you oinking around for some
gossip to write about me.
Well, I only want to ask about your Mast―

Actually, this may be a good opportunity to probe for her #C000246204SG#CDEF.
May as well ask a question while I have the chance.
Ask about her upcoming plans.
Ask about the truth behind her scandal.
Isn't it embarrassing to appear THIS many times?

I came up with a ground-breaking idea.
I'll stick an entry ticket on the packaging.

An entry ticket… for a meet-and-greet?
An autograph session?
Stop it, anything more is asking for trouble.

No. It'll grant you the privilege of
being slapped by my prized tail.

Y-you'd have to be a diehard fan to want that!
But for some reason, I get the feeling that there
are quite a few orders lined up!

It fills a niche!
Sounds fun!

Targeting a specific audience?
You've really thought this through.

Can we change the title to
"GAL Sabbath～A Fool's Hell-Kaleidoscope"?

It appears that her taste in music isn't the
only thing that's egregious. However,
what's good is that it IS cunning.

It gets my stamp of approval.
Your business has feet to stand on,
you degenerate dragon.

And that's not all. My next single will give
the privilege of being stabbed by my horns.
The next, to be torn by my claws.

Then we'll compare the number of entries,
and have a general selection
with the use of my #RUBS         body  #RUBElethal weapons#REND…!

No matter which part gets chosen,
at the center of them all is a perdition named "#C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF"…!

Hee hee hee. Surprised you, didn't it? Actually,
I also have a plan to form a group with sisters.
Of course, every member will just be me.

But, hee hee hee―――Hyah hee hee hee!
Well done, #[piggy][squirrely]#. Well done.

You instantly understood the charm of my plans!
You're more promising cattle than I thought!
I lov―――err, erm, I kind of like you!

Alright! I'm in a good mood,
so I'll answer your previous question.
"Who is your Master," that one.

Really!
I want to know, I want to know!
Please tell me, oh Super Idol!

It's heartbreaking to watch this play out; her
being deceived. You're leading her by the nose,
Praetor. String her a little further along.

…sorry, looks like I instantly got left
behind by all this excitement. Keep doing your
thing, Master…

Kyaa! We wanna know! We wanna knoowwww!
Tell us #C236196003Eliza#CDEF, you sucker!

Mhm. I'm also curious.
Tell us of the prospects that await us.

Gosh, what am I going to do with you, #[piggy][squirrely]#!
Since I can't say no to those eyes,
I'll tell you, as a super special service.

What a nice question. It's very much like what
an idol would get! Romance is the biggest
taboo―it's natural to be curious about it.

Okay! Hound me, be nasty with your
cross-examination! Bow before my 
#ROFS0001#RUBS skill in disregarding#RUBEcomplete silence#REND!!

I'm thankful that she's so eager,
but I wasn't asking about the blood idol's scandals.

I just kinda went with the flow and
asked something that sounded appropriate…

Then indulge me with some ad lib. Ask
something like―yeah, to catch me off guard…
"Is it true you have the hots for #[piggy][squirrely]#?"

#[Piggy][Squirrely]#…?
#[Piggy][Squirrely]#, as in… #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF!?

Wait, #C236196003Lancer#CDEF! I tolerate gossipping about love
affairs, but I can't allow this one. Just how
much of my rival do you intend to become!?

Huhhh? What are you TALKING about?
The person in question flat out rejects you,
done. Make funnier jokes.

Hm? Is that true? …you move swiftly,
#C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF. Also, you have no standards.
Even the #C236196003King of Heroes#CDEF is disgusted.

Dummy. That was obviously just an example.
I told you to "catch me off guard," didn't I?

All you can do is be plain, making me look
better; you look like you would do anything I
say; and make for an innocent #[butler][maid]#… huh?

Could it be? Are #[piggy][squirrely]# and me surprisingly
compatible…?
Do we happen to be a good match…?

――――Ah! There's no way cattle can be
a good match for me. I don't even need to keep
it a secret. It's out of the question.

This won't do. It turned out to be
surprisingly silly. Don't you have any
other questions?

The aching in my hand stopped.
Apparently, it WAS too early to expose her secrets.

My Master… Frankly, I'm not very willing to
answer. But if I don't say it, you'll bother
me about it later… Fine. I'll tell you.

You're pretending to ask a question
just to embarrass me! I-I'm not embarrassed!

Firstly, do you HAVE to phrase it like that?
This is my long-awaited reappearance――
my re-release, my "best of" edition!

Still, this pacing is a little fast. Or rather…
Well, frankly, there isn't any value in it.

And yeah, I do get the feeling that having the same outfit
is what's making this feel like a rehash.

EVERYBODY keeps harping on about the #ROFS0002#RUBS   model#RUBEexterior#REND!
Do you have no words for what's important―
the #RUBS   stats#RUBEinterior#REND?

The reason my appearance is the same is because
it's so perfect it CAN'T change. The designers
are the ones who lose out!
Then I'd like for her to at least change her name or something.

Like, #C236196003Elizabeth Custom#CDEF.
Or like, #C236196003Elizabeth Zero#CDEF.

That's got nothing to do with dragons!
You do intend for ME to be summoned, right!?

Then I'll just have to call that guy in.
What I need now is the straight-man I always
have with me…!

I don't want to do this, but…
come on, #RUBSattendant#RUBEMaster#REND!

Hm? If I recall correctly, this guy was…
Rider's walking wallet… or something.
My eyes must be tricking me. There's NO WAY.
That's #C236196003Shinji Matou#CDEF―――

Yep. Though I'm not too happy about
getting stuck with another red and loud woman.

I should be able to make good use of her,
despite that. #C236196003BB#CDEF came crying to me, begging.
So I agreed to go along with it.

I'm shocked… At what point did you double-cross
us? Going for number one in most scummy
and hopeless as usual, huh?

Heh. Unlike you all, I―――
you idiots get swept up by your emotions, but I
don't. This is the result of a calm decision.

Do it, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF. Declare your surrender!
I, the Game Champ of Asia―――

So there you have it. Honestly, I miss #C236196003Rin#CDEF
and #C236196003Rani#CDEF. They also had their problems, but
their looks suited my tastes.

D-don't interrupt me to start complaining!
Don't you have any manners, "aristocrat"!?

Ha. Haven't you seen your own results?
All you've done is lose, so I, a genius, was
scouted out to come help you.

Huh? "Genius"? You just happened to be
"scouted out" while you were quivering with
fear in a corner of the Labyrinth!

*kgh*. That's rich, coming from you.
You were in a corner of the Imaginary Number
Space―――

AHHH AHHH! I can't understand sounds
from lifeforms lower than cattle!
This dumb rat SURE is annoying!

Wha-dum…!?
You're that one that's dumb! Dummy, dummy!
What's your deal!? Dummy, dummy, dummy!!

While ignoring our existence,
these two repeat their #RUBS   "Dummy!"#RUBEbickerings#REND ad infinitum.
…this is awful. Awful in a lot of ways.

I don't think I was like that when I was in his
place… Maybe being a Master affects you in some
way. What do you think, Miss #C236196003Tohsaka#CDEF?

What do you mean, #C236196003Sakura#CDEF? …hey, #C236196003Rani#CDEF!
Don't give her that look of comprehension!
I'm no member of the PITY PARTY!

An angry voice over the transmission rings in my ears.
Whether here or there, awful things are everywhere.

I knew I had things to worry about without #C236196003Leo#CDEF here―――
no, actually, this would be even more awful if he was here.

We need to end this bickering so we can
probe for #C236196003Elizabeth#CDEF's #C000246204SG#CDEF.

Ahem. Kids who talk too much get a piece of
#C236196003BB#CDEF's Slam of Justice～!

Oops… It just sorta, happened.
Umm, ahem. Sorry about that, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF.
My hand slipped.

For YOU are the strongest Master, surpassing
#C236196003Leo Bistario Harwey#CDEF, humanity's greatest #ROFS0001#RUBS  Magus#RUBE#C000246204Wizard#CDEF#REND.

As long as I have a Servant,
I'm the one who can win the #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF.

You know this, don't you, #C236196003BB#CDEF:
considering who I am, you'll be paying me what
I deserve for helping you out.
Yes, it's already been worked out.

Once I reach the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF,
the Near Side #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF will be transferred to…
Pardon, I will humbly offer it to you.

If anyone is fit to be King of the Moon,
it's you, #C236196003Shinji#CDEF鷙

Heh―――Heheh, hahahaha! Yep, that's right!
I'm one of the chosen ones, the last-standing
winner!
#C236196003BB#CDEF's coaxing turns #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's grimace into a smile.

His expression is condescending.
It's #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's usual expression.
Even though I'm used to seeing it,
this time it has a hint of desperation―――

Maybe it's because I saw with my own two eyes
how his #C000246204Holy Grail War#CDEF ended…

It matters not in the slightest who turns
against us. Whoever the opponent is, I need only
to do my best for you, #RUBS  Master#RUBEPraetor#REND.

However… Facing #C236196003Shinji#CDEF again must be painful
for you. It's a little distressing, knowing
what will happen after our victory.

…#C236196003Shinji Matou#CDEF may be shallow, but he's a
clever man. Normally, he wouldn't fall for such
blatant smooth talking… normally.

Recalling the reality he got hit with, I get his
wishful thinking… but why doesn't he realize
that he's making things harder for himself?

*sigh*. This person truly is hopeless.
That's why he's so childish.
…wait, he actually is a child, isn't he?

What's daunting you? There's no other
opponent who can be as easily defeated in all
of mind, skill, and body.

Hmph. I'll show you that I can easily protect my
own secrets, without relying on this RAT.

Now. The opening talk ends here.
Let my revival concert shake you to the core!

This time, victory WILL be MINE.
Yes… definitely.

The two disappear.
They probably left and went to the
interior of the Labyrinth.

There are signs of multiple enemies.
It appears they may take some time to
deal with…

They're nothing more than a mishmash of widgets.
They can't stop you with your current
strength. …isn't that right?

Obviously.
And now we ended up with another goal:
bring #C236196003Shinji#CDEF to his senses.

We can't back down now.
Even if it just happened to be temporarily configured in us,
he and I have an unsavory tie to one another.

Mhm! This will become a final battle
with my fated rival for me as well!
Let's rally ourselves, Master!

Don't you get worried either.
It's the same old Labyrinth exploration.
Focus up, and let's go.

An "unsavory tie," huh? Then it must be done.
This performance is uninspiring, but I'll go
along with it, for your sake.

Upon advancing into the Labyrinth,
we approach a hill with enemies huddled on it.

They're tightly packed into the thin path,
so we can't avoid them.
This malicious setup is―――definitely #C236196003Shinji#CDEF's doing.

Nice, you look real fed up!
Thanks for giving me the reaction
I was hoping for, #C236196003#GIVEN#CDEF.

These guys are as sturdy as it gets.
Even if you beat one, will you have the stamina
to climb up? I call this the―――

It breaks your heart with a CRACK:
the hearthrob ☆ Golem-covered Hill of Hell!

Again with your bull! And you're overdoing it
with the "heartthrob"! Agh… Anyway, come up
the hill and show me how you pant like a dog!
………somehow, we climbed all the way up.

It looks like the Labyrinth still continues further,
but I guess we made it past the first hurdle.
